name: Scores
author: meirdick
description: Live sports scores in the Omarchy bar: follow teams across the US majors, college and world soccer, with a keyboard-driven scoreboard, standings and optional alerts.

barWidget.description: Live score and clock for the teams you follow, a next-game countdown when nothing is on, and a panel with today's games, league scoreboards, standings and per-game detail.

schema.label: Followed teams
schema.description: Comma-separated league:ABBR pairs, e.g. "mlb:BOS, nfl:NYJ, eng.1:ARS". Easier to set from the panel: press / to search and f to follow.

schema.label: Followed leagues
schema.description: Comma-separated league slugs, e.g. "nfl, eng.1". A followed league is polled and all its games count as yours. Easier to set from the panel: press L, then f on a league. Any ESPN slug works, including ones not in the built-in list.

schema.label: Live refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often scores refresh while a followed game is in progress. ESPN advertises a 3-second cache, so anything above that is polite; below 15 buys very little.

schema.label: Idle refresh (seconds)
schema.description: Floor for the refresh rate when nothing you follow is playing. The widget backs off to an hour when no followed team plays today.

schema.label: Bar format
schema.description: How much fits in the bar. "compact" drops the game clock; "icon" shows only the glyph and keeps everything in the panel.

schema.label: Rotate between live games (seconds)
schema.description: When several followed games are live at once, how long each one holds the bar.

schema.label: Show the in-game situation
schema.description: Count, outs and runners for baseball; down and distance for football. Shown in the panel, never in the bar.

schema.label: Show games you do not follow
schema.description: Adds an "Also today" section under your own teams. Turn off for a panel that only ever shows your teams.

schema.label: Keep finals in the bar for (hours)
schema.description: How long a finished game keeps the bar slot before it reverts to the next-game countdown.

schema.label: Notify when a followed game starts
schema.description: Off by default. Every alert here is opt-in.

schema.label: Notify on every score
schema.description: Fires for either team in a followed game. The loudest option here — a high-scoring basketball game will notify dozens of times.

schema.label: Notify on the final score
schema.description: One notification per followed game. The quietest useful setting.

schema.label: Notify when a followed game gets close late
schema.description: Fires once per game when the margin is within the threshold below and the game is in its last period.

schema.label: Close-game margin
schema.description: Score difference that counts as close. 1 suits baseball, hockey and soccer; raise it to about 6 for football or basketball.

schema.label: Close-game clock (seconds)
schema.description: Only treat a game as close once its clock is under this. Ignored for sports without a running clock, such as baseball.

schema.label: Provider chain override
schema.description: JSON mapping a league to the providers to try in order, e.g. {"mlb":["mlb","espn"]}. Providers are "espn" (all leagues), "mlb" (statsapi.mlb.com) and "nhl" (api-web.nhle.com). Leave empty for ESPN first everywhere.

schema.label: ESPN host override
schema.description: Escape hatch for the day ESPN moves. Empty means https://site.web.api.espn.com. Do not point this at a host that requires a browser User-Agent.
